title: PM-Vidyalaxmi Education Loan Scheme Official Cabinet Approval
source_name: Press Information Bureau (PIB), Government of India
summary: The Union Cabinet approved the PM-Vidyalaxmi scheme to provide financial support to meritorious students for higher education. Offers collateral-free and guarantor-free education loans for students admitted to top 860 Quality Higher Educational Institutions (QHEIs), featuring a 3% interest subvention for families with annual income up to ₹8,00,000 on loans up to ₹10 lakh. Applications are processed exclusively online via the official PM-Vidyalaxmi unified digital portal.
